name: Pretty Little Rituals
tagline: Beauty worth the splurge, essentials worth the shelf space.
description: Luxury beauty and everyday essentials from Amazon: skincare, K-beauty, makeup, hair, fragrance and gifts, with a splurge and an everyday pick for every step.
author: Vallari Gadre

sections.name: Skincare
sections.blurb: Cleansers, serums, masks and sunscreen, from the splurge to the bathroom staple.

sections.name: K-Beauty
sections.blurb: The Korean skincare Amazon can't keep in stock, paired with the luxury it rivals.

sections.name: Makeup
sections.blurb: Skin tints, lips and party looks, at both ends of the price range.

sections.name: Hair & Tools
sections.blurb: Blowouts, scalp care and the beauty tools that earn their shelf space.

sections.name: Fragrance & Body
sections.blurb: Signature perfumes, body care and the art of layering a scent that is yours.

sections.name: Gift Guides
sections.blurb: Beauty gifts that look expensive, at every budget.

heroAlt: A marble vanity with a luxury perfume bottle, a lipstick and a blush silk ribbon in soft light
authorBio: I'm V. I spent ten years in fashion retail buying and merchandise planning, choosing what earns a place on the shelf and what gets left behind. I bring the same eye to beauty: every pick here is chosen from real Amazon listings, ingredient lists and thousands of shopper reviews, with one splurge and one everyday option so you decide where your money goes.
